findings.title: An operator decision relayed through a woken orchestrator is recorded as the orchestrator's objection, so a later wakeup may clear it
A standing objection is not surfaced by `orchid status`, only by `task show` and the boundary page
Only docs/engines/claude.md documents the objection paragraph, though the Part AF sweep requires it of all four review adapters

summary: The durable objection, the operator-only routing, the closed `task advance` door and the reviewer-pack carry are all implemented with non-vacuous RED cases and a complete sweep of the other suites' ha
